article.title: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，以長上下文處理跨格式工作
article.summary: Google推出Gemini 4 Neon，提供100萬token上下文，可把多種檔案放在同一工作脈絡中處理。
highlights: 輸入包括試算表、PDF、圖表、音訊及影片。
模型在Gemini API等服務推出，Gemini應用程式的開放方案為Pro及Ultra。
article.why: 跨格式活動簡報可減少分開整理文件的工序，團隊可評估長上下文是否有助把素材與成效資料連結成同一份交付。
article.next_step: 以同一活動的PDF及成效試算表作固定輸入，要求輸出附來源位置的摘要，檢查跨檔案引用是否準確。
article.detail: Google把Neon定位為處理長時間、多步驟工作流程的模型，並提供四個思考層級供選擇。上下文token是模型可接收內容的容量單位，實際能放入多少檔案仍視內容而定。團隊可以先以一份有標準答案的活動資料測試，再決定適合把哪些跨格式工作交給模型處理。
article.title_en: Google launches Gemini 4 Neon for long-context, mixed-format work
article.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon with a one-million-token context window for work spanning multiple file types.
highlights_en: Inputs include spreadsheets, PDFs, charts, audio and video.
Rollout includes the Gemini API, with Pro and Ultra access in the Gemini app.
article.why_en: Campaign teams can assess whether one long context connects assets and performance data into a single deliverable.
article.next_step_en: Use one campaign PDF and spreadsheet to request a source-located summary and check cross-file references.
article.detail_en: Google positions Neon for long, multi-step workflows with four thinking levels. Tokens measure context capacity, so file coverage depends on content. Test a campaign dataset with known answers before assigning mixed-format work.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
